breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided contradictory boundary conditions: both Neumann (u_x=0) and Dirichlet (u=0) on the same boundaries. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect Dirichlet condition. The agent's generated specification also correctly removed the contradictory Dirichlet condition and only included the instruction to apply zero-Neumann boundary conditions, thus resolving the inconsistency.
